alignment.caveat: no Phase-0 verdict for this signal on this backbone

alignment_proj.caveat: regime-level 2nd reader: co-separates 5/5 but reads the far-shift regime, not forgetting magnitude

cka_drift.caveat: canary A1 reader (task-A content drift) — trustworthy but canary-bound (needs retained task-A data) and reads change, so needs a two-sided control

cka_drift_proj.caveat: backbone content-drift does not port past-data-free at the projector (3/5, inverts on a seed)

cosine_drift.caveat: drift reads representation change, not forgetting; needs a matched control to subtract benign plasticity

cosine_drift_proj.caveat: past-data-free reader: projector frame-churn separates two-sided 5/5, keeps no task-A data (needs drift_surfaces)

knn_acc.caveat: ground-truth canary probe — trustworthy but needs labels

linear_acc.caveat: ground-truth canary probe — trustworthy but needs labels

mean_feature_var.caveat: read at the projector, not the backbone

offdiag_cov.caveat: read at the projector, not the backbone

offdiag_cov_proj.caveat: redundancy-collapse detector (fires ~13-20x on whitening-ablated Barlow); a principled null under point collapse

rankme.caveat: backbone has genuine in-regime blind spots — read collapse at the projector, keep the backbone as reference only

rankme_proj.caveat: universal collapse detector; but thins to ~1 marginal, LR-conditional reader (~2.17x, on the 2.0 bar) in the correlated single-pass corner
collapse-specificity guard: full-rank throughout means forgetting, not collapse — not itself a forgetting reader

uniformity.caveat: read at the projector, not the backbone

uniformity_proj.caveat: long-horizon-only — quiet single-pass, rho~0.92 redundant with rankme_proj
calibrated to collapse; mis-signals on forgetting (flips direction, separates 3/5)
